events.content: Deborah: Hey Jolene, nice to meet you! How's your week going? Anything fun happened?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Hi Deb! Good to meet you! Yeah, my week's been busy. I finished an electrical engineering project last week - took a lot of work, but it's done now. Anything fun happening for you?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Congrats! Last week I visited a place that holds a lot of memories for me. It was my mother`s old house.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Why does it hold such special memories for you?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a woman in a wheelchair hugging a woman in a wheelchair] It was full of memories, she passed away a few years ago. This is our last photo together.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a room with a bench and a window] Sorry about your loss, Deb. My mother also passed away last year. This is my room in her house, I also have many memories there. Is there anything special about it you remember?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: My mom's house had a special bench near the window. She loved to sit there every morning and take in the view. I come to sit here sometimes, it helps me stay connected to her.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a heart shaped pendant with a bird on it] Staying connected is super important. Do you have something to remember her by? This pendant reminds me of my mother, she gave it to me in 2010  in Paris.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Yes, I also have a pendant that reminds me of my mother. And what is special for you about your jewelry?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It has a special symbol on it that represents freedom for me. It's a nice reminder to go for my goals and not get held back.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: It should really give you strength and energy!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Do you have goals?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: One of my goals is to keep teaching yoga and supporting my community. I'm passionate about helping people find peace and joy through it.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: What inspired you to go down this route?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Yoga helped me find peace during a rough time, and now I'm passionate about sharing that with others.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It is truly inspiring!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Gotta run, bye!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Looking forward to the next chat!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a woman hugging a woman who is sitting on a couch] Hey Jolene, sorry to tell you this but my dad passed away two days ago. It's been really tough on us all - his sudden death left us all kinda shell-shocked. I'm trying to channel my grief by spending more time with family and cherishing the memories. These moments remind me to live life fully.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Sorry to hear about your dad, Deborah. Losing a parent is tough - how's it going for you and your family?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a bride and groom posing for a picture] Even though it's hard, it's comforting to look back on the great memories. We looked at the family album. Photos give me peace during difficult times. This is my parents' wedding in 1993.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: They were a beautiful couple!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: My husband and I are trying to be as good a family as my parents were!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: What do you value in your relationship?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a note written to someone on a piece of paper] It is love, and openness that have kept us close all these years. Being there for each other has made us both happy. Look what letter I received yesterday!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: What touching words! Who is this letter from?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: The group members sent this to me! They thanked me for the positive influence I had on them. Those moments remind me why I'm so passionate about yoga.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Where do you most often do yoga?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a living room with a television and a window] This is one of the places where I do it.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Where is it?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That's my old home. I go there now and then for my mom, who passed away. Sitting in that spot by the window gives me peace.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Must be great to have that place where you feel connected to her.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a window seat in a room with a window] Yeah, it's special. I can feel her presence when I sit there and it comforts me.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Wow, it sounds like that spot holds a lot of sentimental value. Does it bring back any special memories?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a view of the sky from an airplane window] Yeah, Jolene. She'd sit there every night with a book and a smile, reading was one of her hobbies. It was one of her favorite places in the house.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: What other hobbies did your mother have?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Travel was also her great passion!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a bed with a snake head sticking out of it] I want to show you one of my snakes! They always calm me down and make me happy. This is Susie.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Having a pet totally brightens up your life. It's great that it brings you comfort. Do you have any fun moments with your pet that you'd like to share?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a snake sticking its head out of a blanket]  I was playing video games and my pet just slinked out of her cage and coiled up next to me - it was too funny! My second snake Seraphim did it. Look at her sly eyes!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Awww, that's so nice!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: I bought it a year ago in Paris.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Cool, Jolene! Pets bring so much happiness!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a person laying in bed with a dog watching tv] They are very unusual pets! Here's me and my partner gaming last week - it's so fun. We played the game "Detroit" on the console. We are both crazy about this activity!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Did your boyfriend teach you to play?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Even as a child I learned to play on my own.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Do you only play old games or try new ones?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: We are planning to play "Walking Dead" next Saturday.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Take care and keep spreading those good vibes!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! You too, take care. See ya!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a table with a robot on it and a laptop] Hi Deb! How're you? I've been busy. My engineering professor gave us a huge robotics project. It's tough but fun, it's making me get creative and problem-solve.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Hey Jolene! It's great to hear from you. It sounds challenging but interesting! It must be really putting your creative and problem-solving skills to the test. How did you feel when you first received the project? Are you enjoying working on it?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: When I got it, I felt a mix of emotions - excited and nervous. But now, I'm really enjoying it! It's like trying to solve a puzzle, figuring out the best design and programming. Seeing the robot come together is awesome too!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a yellow sign with a picture of a family] That's awesome, Jolene! You're enjoying the process. It must be really satisfying to see it come together. Keep up the good work! Oh, by the way, I met my new neighbor Anna yesterday!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: How did you two meet?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: It happened at yoga in the park.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! It's great connecting with people who have similar interests. Did you two talk about it?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Yeah, we talked about how it has improved our lives and the sense of community it gives.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a purse with a plant on a table] Sounds great!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Have you ever thought about resuming yoga?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Well... we planned to play the console with my partner.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: It's also good that you have something to do together.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks for the kind words!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Gotta run bye!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: See you soon!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Jolene: Hey Deborah! Good to hear from you. How've you been? I've been on an emotional rollercoaster lately, but I'm coping.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Good to hear from you. All good here - how about you? Anything new happening lately?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: I had a major milestone last week and it went really well - I'm so relieved and proud. It was a huge accomplishment for me as an engineer.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That's awesome. You must have worked really hard for that. I'm so proud of you. Care to share more about it?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks so much! I had to plan and research a lot to design and build a sustainable water purifier for a rural community in need. It was tough, but I loved the experience.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Your engineering skills really made a difference for people in a rural area. That's amazing! How did it feel when you saw it working?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It was such a surreal moment. Seeing it working and providing clean water to the community was incredibly satisfying. It reminded me of how engineering can make a difference in people's lives. It made me feel like I had a purpose and had done something good.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: So, what are your career aspirations now?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: I want to keep working in engineering and continue to make a positive impact on communities in need by creating sustainable solutions. My goal is to contribute towards making the world a better place with my work.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: I'm sure great things will keep coming your way. Keep up the good work and follow your passions!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Your support means a lot. I'm determined to keep going and make a difference. Your encouragement really motivates me to pursue my passions.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of two women in a dance studio doing a dance pose] When things get tough, just take a deep breath and remember why you're doing this. This is where I spend a lot of my time, teaching yoga. It's a great way to find balance and reconnect with ourselves. I bonded with Anna during yesterday's l yoga class.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Wow, that's awesome! What new poses did you try?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a woman doing a yoga pose on a chair] We were trying out different dance poses, like Warrior II, which builds strength and boosts focus.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Is it difficult to do?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Yes, but this brought us closer to Anna! We supported each other, that means a lot.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Can you explain how to do it?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Sure! To do this modified pose, sit on the edge of a chair with your feet planted. Twist your torso to one side and use your hand on your knee for support. You'll feel a stretch in your back and shoulders as you hold it for a few breaths, then switch sides. It's great for relaxing tense muscles.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a book shelf with a lot of books on it] Sounds really hard! Here's my bookshelf!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That's quite a collection! Have you had a favorite book lately? I'd love to hear your thoughts.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks Deborah! I'm really into this book called "Sapiens" - it's a fascinating look at human history and how technology has affected us. It's giving me a lot to think about!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Great, this is interesting! Have you come across any recent ones that really struck you?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Two weeks ago I read "Avalanche" by Neal Stephenson in one sitting!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That sounds cool, Jolene. Stories can be so powerful - they can teach us, motivate us, and bring us together.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: I also read a recent story about someone who became successful despite facing numerous challenges. It really showed me that anything is possible if you believe and work hard.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a bouquet of flowers in a vase on a table] That's a really powerful message. It reminds me of someone special and their grace and strength when they faced hardships. Check out this creation!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Wow, Deb! That's beautiful! Can you tell me the backstory of that bouquet?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: My friend gave me this bouquet when I was struggling, and it gives me hope and courage. I'm filled with warmth and appreciation when I look at it.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: That's really sweet. Such a small thing can make a real difference.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: It's amazing how something as simple as flowers can make a real difference. Nature sure is beautiful.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Where are some of your favorite nature spots?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Oh, there's so many great places! My favorite is a park with a forest trail - it's so calming getting lost in nature. Then there's this beach nearby that I love - the sound of the waves and the sand under my feet make me feel all peaceful and happy. Do you have any favorite spots, Jolene?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a person walking on the beach with a surfboard] Here's a picture I took on vacation last summer in Bogota. It was so beautiful and calming watching the sunset over the water. It definitely made me appreciate nature's calming power.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a small island with a lone boat in the water] That sounds great, Jolene. Nature's calming for sure. Guess it helps us forget the daily craziness and find inner peace. No wonder you're a fan! I like to come to this spot by the water near my mom's old house. It's where I reflect on her life and find some peace. Being surrounded by nature helps a lot.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: That's so touching! Do you have any little traditions that you do when you come to reflect on your mom?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: [Image: a photo of a woman wearing a white shirt and a gold chain necklace] Do you remember this amulet from her? Whenever I come here, I bring it with me. It's how I feel her love and stay close to her. Holding it brings me comfort.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It's amazing how something so small can have such a big impact, huh?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Yeah, even small things like this can make a big difference. It's a reminder of all the love and strength we have inside, connecting us to people we've lost and comforting us.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It can keep them close in our hearts every day.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Anna also has a pendant that she wears in memory of her mother! This also brought us closer.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: It's nice to have those reminders as a source of strength when we need it.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Life's tough but hang in there. Look to your sources of strength and you'll do great. Stay in touch, take care of yourself, and know I'm always here to cheer you on!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! Your encouragement means a lot to me. I'll definitely stay in touch. Bye, take care and keep shining!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Stay safe!  Bye!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Hey Deborah! Been a few days since we last talked so I wanted to fill you in on something cool. Last Wednesday I did a mini retreat to assess where I'm at in life. It was a dope experience that totally gave me a new outlook.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Hey Jolene! Sounds great. Taking time to reflect can be really awesome. Did you gain any new insights from it?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Yep! I achieved so much more than I imagined. It was a real confidence boost.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: You deserve credit for stepping outside your comfort zone and believing in yourself. What cool stuff did you accomplish at the retreat?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: I really accomplished something with my engineering project - I came up with some neat solutions and I'm really excited about it.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Let's go into more detail.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Green tech could really make a difference in disadvantaged areas. I'd like to look into it and see how I can contribute. Hey, speaking of helping out, I had an idea: a volunteer program where engineers teach STEM to underprivileged kids. What do you think of that?
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That sounds great, Jolene! It's a great way to help and inspire others. They would benefit a lot from your knowledge. Have you thought of a plan yet?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Haven't finished planning yet but I'm thinking of teaming up with local schools/centers to do workshops. We could even invite engineers as guest speakers to show kids their career options.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Having guest speakers, like them, would definitely give the kids a real-world view. Have you reached out to any schools or centers yet?
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: No, not yet. I want to solidify the plan first. Can't wait to start reaching out, though!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: That makes sense. I'm excited to hear how you reach out and help those kids. Let me know how it goes!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: [Image: a photo of a notebook with a pen and a notebook with a page of notes] I'll keep you posted! Appreciate the support! Here are my sketches in the planner.
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: Sounds like you're doing great. Let me know if you need more tips or information.
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Thanks, Deb! If I need anything else, I'll let you know. You're awesome!
events.speaker: Jolene

events.content: Deborah: You're awesome too! Take care!
events.speaker: Deborah

events.content: Jolene: Stay safe!
events.speaker: Jolene
